These earbuds feature QuietSmart 3.0 Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation, effectively reducing surrounding noise by up to 50dB for an immersive listening experience whether you’re traveling, working, or relaxing. Specially-Tuned Hybrid Driver System

The EarFun Air Pro 4+ features a specially-tuned hybrid driver system that combines the ultra-light FeatherBA Balanced Armature with a powerful 10mm composite dynamic driver. This advanced dual-driver configuration is custom-tuned to deliver a rich, full-spectrum sound experience, balancing deep, resonant bass, lifelike mids, and crisp, soaring treble with precision. Whether you're enjoying vocals, acoustic music, or complex instrumentals, the EarFun Air Pro 4+ Earbuds ensure studio-grade accuracy and breathtaking clarity, bringing every note to life exactly as the artist intended.

Nano Side-Fitted Acoustic Architecture (NSAA)

Nano Side-Fitted Acoustic Architecture is an advanced audio design that optimizes the alignment between dynamic and balanced armature drivers in hybrid driver systems. In traditional setups, magnetic interference between these drivers can reduce the armature’s high-frequency performance. To overcome this, NSAA employs an 11-degree angled alignment between the dynamic driver and the balanced armature, a configuration determined through extensive acoustic testing. This precise arrangement effectively minimizes high-frequency attenuation, resulting in clearer, more detailed, and accurate treble reproduction—enhancing the overall sound balance and fidelity for a more immersive listening experience.

Oval Acoustic Port for Better Fit & Sound

The Enhanced Oval Acoustic Port on the EarFun Air Pro 4+ is designed for both superior sound and comfort. Its larger, shorter oval shape optimizes acoustic tuning, reducing sound dispersion for clearer audio with stronger sound pressure. Ergonomically contoured to fit the ear canal, it ensures a secure, comfortable fit, making long listening sessions more enjoyable without fatigue.

Crystal-Clear Calls Anywhere

The EarFun Air Pro 4+ is equipped with 6 enhanced microphones, AI noise reduction, and cVc 8.0 technology to smartly isolate your voice and block out surrounding noise. This ensures clear, natural calls even in busy or noisy environments, making it perfect for work, travel, or on-the-go conversations.
